results.name: Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem finsetSum_coeff {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff (∑ b ∈ s, f b) n = ∑ b ∈ s, coeff (f b) n :=
  map_sum (lcoeff R n) _ _

results.name: Polynomial.sum_X_index
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem sum_X_index {S : Type*} [AddCommMonoid S] {f : ℕ → R → S} (hf : f 1 0 = 0) :
    (X : R[X]).sum f = f 1 1 :=
  sum_monomial_index 1 f hf

results.name: Finset.card
results.source_text:
/-- `s.card` is the number of elements of `s`, aka its cardinality.

The notation `#s` can be accessed in the `Finset` locale. -/
def card (s : Finset α) : ℕ :=
  Multiset.card s.1

theorem val_injective (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : Function.Injective (val : ZMod n → ℕ) := by
  cases n

  intro a b h
  dsimp [ZMod]
  ext
  exact h

results.name: SuperSymmetry.SU5.ChargeSpectrum.preimageOfFinset_card_eq
results.source_text:
lemma preimageOfFinset_card_eq (S5 S10 : Finset 𝓩) (f : 𝓩 →+ 𝓩1) (x : ChargeSpectrum 𝓩1) :
    preimageOfFinsetCard S5 S10 f x =
    (preimageOfFinset S5 S10 f x).card := by
  rw [preimageOfFinset, Finset.card_map]
  simp only [Option.map_eq_map, Finset.product_eq_sprod]
  repeat rw [Finset.card_product]
  simp [preimageOfFinsetCard, mul_assoc]

results.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.oddShiftFst
results.source_text:
/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + n + n)` via the first `n`.
  This is then casted to `Fin (2 * n + 1)`. -/
def oddShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n + 1) :=
  Fin.cast (odd_shift_eq n) (Fin.castAdd n (Fin.natAdd 1 j))
results.docstring:
The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + n + n)` via the first `n`.
This is then casted to `Fin (2 * n + 1)`.

results.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.oddShiftShiftFst
results.source_text:
/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + n + 1 + n.succ)` via the first `n` and casted
  to `Fin (2 * n.succ + 1)`. -/
def oddShiftShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ + 1) :=
  Fin.cast (odd_shift_shift_eq n) (Fin.castAdd n.succ (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 j)))
results.docstring:
The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + n + 1 + n.succ)` via the first `n` and casted
to `Fin (2 * n.succ + 1)`.
